_comment: Fixed credentials for the two-agent end-to-end run (e2e/two-user-flow.mjs).
THROWAWAY TEST DATA ONLY — never use these passphrases for a real identity.
They are committed on purpose so a run is reproducible and a failing test can
be re-driven by hand in a browser with the same accounts.
Usernames get a per-run suffix because the directory refuses a name that is
already registered to a different identity; the passphrases stay constant.

users.passphrase: e2e alice identity passphrase — test only
e2e bob identity passphrase — test only

chatPassphrase: e2e shared chat passphrase — test only
